segments.ja461:1.1: Etha lakkhaṇa sītā ca, ubho otarathodakaṃ;
segments.ja461:2.3: Pitaraṃ kālakataṃ [kālaṅkataṃ (ka.)] sutvā, na taṃ pasahate dukhaṃ.
segments.ja461:3.1: Yaṃ na sakkā nipāletuṃ, posena lapataṃ bahuṃ;
segments.ja461:4.1: Daharā ca hi vuddhā ca [ye vuddhā (sī. aṭṭha.), ye vuḍḍhā (syā.)], ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā;
segments.ja461:4.3: Aḍḍhā ceva daliddā ca, sabbe maccuparāyaṇā.
segments.ja461:5.3: Evaṃ jātāna maccānaṃ, nicca maraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja461:6.1: Sāyameke na dissanti, pāto diṭṭhā bahujjanā;
segments.ja461:6.3: Pāto eke na dissanti, sāyaṃ diṭṭhā bahujjanā.
segments.ja461:8.1: Kiso vivaṇṇo bhavati, hiṃsamattānamattano [mattanā (sī. aṭṭha. su. ni.590)];
segments.ja461:8.3: Na tena petā pālenti, niratthā paridevanā.
segments.ja461:9.3: Evampi dhīro sutavā, medhāvī paṇḍito naro;
segments.ja461:10.1: Macco ekova [ekova macco (sī. syā. pī.)] acceti, ekova jāyate kule;
segments.ja461:11.1: Tasmā hi dhīrassa bahussutassa, sampassato lokamimaṃ parañca;
segments.ja461:11.3: Aññāya dhammaṃ hadayaṃ manañca, sokā mahantāpi na tāpayanti.
segments.ja461:12.1: Sohaṃ dassañca bhokkhañca, bharissāmi ca [sohaṃ yasañca bhogañca, bhariyāpi ca (syā. ka.)] ñātake;
